title: On Surviving the loss of the whole fleet
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：survive　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 survive 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the coach ① survived the loss of the whole fleet in the rain, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② survives the loss of the whole fleet without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ survive the loss of the whole fleet at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ survived the loss of the whole fleet before — a line in the record for April 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Surviving the loss of the whole fleet in the rain, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ survive two hard winters in the hills without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Survive two hard winters in the hills at once and never mention it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ survives two hard winters in the hills in the rain every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ survived the loss of the whole fleet again when nobody else would.

⑩ To survive the loss of the whole fleet, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody survives the loss of the whole fleet without complaint again and somebody must survive the loss of the whole fleet in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 幸存（一般过去式 survived the loss of the whole fleet：1952 年教练头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 幸存（一般现在 survives the loss of the whole fleet：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 幸存（不定式 to survive the loss of the whole fleet：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 幸存（过去完成时 had survived the loss of the whole fleet：1946 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 幸存（动名词 surviving the loss of the whole fleet 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 活过（survive two hard winters in the hills：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去活过在山里熬过两个严冬）
G. v. 活过（survive two hard winters in the hills：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 幸存（后段两处：新来的队员照例 survives two hard winters in the hills，而母亲又一次 survived the loss of the whole fleet）

answers.why: survive 意为“幸存”，1952 年教练淋着雨幸存在整支船队覆没时幸存下来，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 survived。
survive 意为“幸存”，自那以后教练毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 survives。
survive 意为“幸存”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯幸存在整支船队覆没时幸存下来”，此处为不定式 to survive the loss of the whole fleet。
survive 意为“幸存”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1959 年之前就有人幸存过，故用过去完成时 had survived。
survive 意为“幸存”，教练说“幸存在整支船队覆没时幸存下来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 surviving the loss of the whole fleet 作主语。
survive 意为“活过”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去活过在山里熬过两个严冬”，should ever 之后用原形 survive two hard winters in the hills。
survive 意为“活过”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻活过在山里熬过两个严冬（survive two hard winters in the hills at once），以后再也不要提起。
survive 意为“幸存”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例活过在山里熬过两个严冬，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 survives。
survive 意为“幸存”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨幸存在整支船队覆没时幸存下来，用一般过去式 survived 叙述。
survive 意为“幸存”，结尾那句是母亲 1964 年的话：要幸存在整支船队覆没时幸存下来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 survive 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the coach survived the loss of the whole fleet in the rain, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach survives the loss of the whole fleet without complaint whenever the field asks.
Surviving the loss of the whole fleet in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever survive two hard winters in the hills without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field survives two hard winters in the hills in the rain every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother survived the loss of the whole fleet again, and the field remembered that half.
